disputed.description: A tier-3 claim a tier-1 source contradicts; `conflict` holds the other source's version. Waiting for the owner.

aliases.title: Aliases
aliases.description: Other and former names, used to match news.

results_urls.title: Results Urls
results_urls.description: Pages where results press releases or reports are published.

financial_calendar_url.title: Financial Calendar Url
financial_calendar_url.description: IR financial calendar page with upcoming report dates.

extra_domains.title: Extra Domains
extra_domains.description: Further domains the earnings check may search and fetch from (the IR and results URLs' domains are always allowed).

sec_cik.title: Sec Cik
sec_cik.description: SEC Central Index Key. US issuers (8-K) and foreign issuers that furnish results on 6-K. Looked up from the ticker when empty.

sec_ticker.title: Sec Ticker
sec_ticker.description: Ticker as EDGAR and Finnhub list it, when it differs from the Trading212 ticker's prefix.

fiscal_year_end_month.title: Fiscal Year End Month
fiscal_year_end_month.description: Month the fiscal year ends in (Apple: 9, Microsoft: 6). Maps fiscal quarters to calendar periods.

price_symbol.title: Price Symbol
price_symbol.description: Stooq symbol for price history when the one derived from OpenFIGI is wrong or missing (e.g. 'sap.de').

reporting_currency.title: Reporting Currency
reporting_currency.description: Currency the company reports in; figures in another are held.

HoldingProfilesConfig.title: HoldingProfilesConfig
HoldingProfilesConfig.description: All holding profiles. Stored as `config_version` rows, domain `holding_profiles`.

holdings.title: Holdings
holdings.description: Every open position once, by value descending.

unchanged.title: Unchanged
unchanged.description: Domains whose body equalled the active version.

next_before_id.title: Next Before Id
next_before_id.description: Pass as before_id for the next page.

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: Sum of the run's step costs; null if none.

failed_step.title: Failed Step
failed_step.description: The first failed step's name, if any.

cron.title: Cron
cron.description: Standard 5-field cron expression (minute hour day month weekday).

runs.title: Runs
runs.description: Runs with at least one costed step in the month.

job_cap_usd.title: Job Cap Usd
job_cap_usd.description: The cap of one run of this type, if any.

critical.title: Critical
critical.description: Keeps running at the monthly cap.

catch_up_on_start.title: Catch Up On Start
catch_up_on_start.description: On worker start, run the data jobs that never succeeded or missed their last scheduled run, one at a time in dependency order.

portfolio_sync.description: Trading212 sync, FX rates and drift. Default: daily at 22:30 Prague time.

earnings_calendar.description: Refresh the report date of holdings reporting soon (see earnings_calendar_settings.refresh_within_days). Default: Sundays 06:00.

earnings_calendar_full.description: Refresh every holding's report date from its IR calendar. Default: quarterly, 1 Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct 05:00.

earnings_due.description: Queue earnings checks for holdings that reported. Default: daily 08:00.

fact_reconcile.description: Check stored results figures against the issuers' 10-Q/10-K XBRL. Default: daily 09:00.

reference_data.description: Identity, listings, legal entities and group structure. Default: Mondays 04:30.

price_history.description: Daily prices (Stooq) and FX history after the close. Default: weekdays 23:15.

holiday_refresh.description: Public holidays for last, this and next year. Default: 2 January and 2 July.

macro_collect.description: FRED, ECB and Eurostat macro series; macro surprises on release days. Default: daily 11:30 (after Eurostat's 11:00 releases).

monitor.description: Alert on failed jobs, missed runs and coverage gaps. Default: every 15 minutes.

news_ingest.description: Ingest, classify, corroborate and alert. Default: every 2 h, 06:00-22:00.

daily_digest.description: Daily digest of the last 24 h. Default: weekdays 07:00.

weekly_digest.description: Weekly digest of the last 7 days. Default: Sundays 18:00.

monthly_review.description: Monthly review on the first weekday of the month (a scheduled run on another day does nothing). Default: 07:00 on the 1st-3rd.

ownership_13f.description: Load new SEC Form 13F data sets (published quarterly). Default: the 5th of each month, 05:00.

JobsConfig.title: JobsConfig
JobsConfig.description:
Schedules for the worker's timed jobs. Stored as `config_version` rows, domain `jobs`.

The worker re-reads this every few minutes, so a saved change applies without a restart.

history.title: History
history.description: Latest verdict per period, newest first.

history_years.title: History Years
history_years.description: Years of history loaded the first time a series is collected (later runs fetch only the recent observations, and fill any gap since the last stored one).

geos.title: Geos
geos.description: Eurostat areas: countries and the euro area (EA21 from 2026).

MacroSettings.title: MacroSettings
MacroSettings.description: Macro series collected into `macro_series` (numbers in digests come only from here).

shares.title: Shares
shares.description: New: shares held; exited: shares held before.

alert_failed_jobs.title: Alert Failed Jobs
alert_failed_jobs.description: Job types whose failed runs alert (once per run).

missed_run_grace_minutes.title: Missed Run Grace Minutes
missed_run_grace_minutes.description: A scheduled run that has not succeeded this long after its slot is missed.

news_coverage_hours.title: News Coverage Hours
news_coverage_hours.description: A holding with no successful news run this long raises a coverage alert.

MonitorSettings.title: MonitorSettings
MonitorSettings.description: Monitoring: failed jobs, missed scheduled runs and per-holding coverage gaps alert.

next_before_id.title: Next Before Id
next_before_id.description: Pass as before_id for the next page.

next_ingest_due_at.title: Next Ingest Due At
next_ingest_due_at.description: The scheduled news check after the last one: the feed is stale once this has passed (plus a margin) with no newer check. Null when the job is disabled.

NewsLabel.title: NewsLabel
NewsLabel.description: The right classification of a news item, for the labelled set.

classification_effort.title: Classification Effort
classification_effort.description: Unset: effort is not sent and the model's default applies. On Haiku 4 models the level sets an extended-thinking budget instead (low 2k to max 32k tokens).

corroboration_effort.title: Corroboration Effort
corroboration_effort.description: Unset: effort is not sent and the model's default applies. On Haiku 4 models the level sets an extended-thinking budget instead (low 2k to max 32k tokens).

corroboration_rounds.title: Corroboration Rounds
corroboration_rounds.description: Corroboration searches per story: one when it is first seen, the rest spread over the re-check window.

recheck_hours.title: Recheck Hours
recheck_hours.description: How long an unconfirmed story is re-checked.

edgar_fts_max_hits.title: Edgar Fts Max Hits
edgar_fts_max_hits.description: Most EDGAR full-text search hits read per query (100 per request; EDGAR serves at most 10,000). A query with more is noted in the collect step.

NewsSettings.title: NewsSettings
NewsSettings.description: The news pipeline after ingest: classification, corroboration.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: 1: the company, regulators, central banks, official newswires. 2: curated outlets. 3: blogs and social (labelled sentiment, never alert alone).

type.title: Type
type.description: rss: an RSS or Atom feed. page: a news page read daily; new links on it become items. edgar: every holding's SEC filings. finnhub: US company news. google_news: a Google News query per holding (unofficial endpoint). rns: UK regulatory announcements per holding (Investegate company page). eqs: German regulatory announcements (EQS News company page from the holding profile's regulatory_news_urls). edgar_fts: SEC full-text search for each holding's watch topics and for other filers naming it.

tickers.title: Tickers
tickers.description: Holdings this source is about (e.g. a company's own IR feed): its items link to them without a name match. Empty: items are matched by name.

macro.title: Macro
macro.description: A macro or central-bank source: its items are kept without matching a holding and appear under Markets and macro.

domain_tiers.title: Domain Tiers
domain_tiers.description: Trust tier per outlet domain (subdomains included). Every holding's IR and results domains count as tier 1.

blocked_domains.title: Blocked Domains
blocked_domains.description: Items from these outlets are dropped.

allowed_domains.title: Allowed Domains
allowed_domains.description: When set, aggregator items (Finnhub, Google News) are kept only from these outlets (and the tiered ones above).

unknown_outlet_tier.title: Unknown Outlet Tier
unknown_outlet_tier.description: Tier for an aggregator's item from an outlet not listed above.

include_tier3.title: Include Tier3
include_tier3.description: Keep tier-3 items (labelled sentiment; they never alert on their own).

google_news_locale.description: The Google News edition searched by google_news sources.

check.title: Check
check.description: The claim verifier's result; null when not checked.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Where a matching event is sent immediately.

during_quiet_hours.title: During Quiet Hours
during_quiet_hours.description: hold_until_end: send when quiet hours end. send: send anyway. digest_only: do not send; it appears in the next digest.

daily_alert_cap.title: Daily Alert Cap
daily_alert_cap.description: Most alerts sent per day (in the quiet-hours timezone); the rest wait for the digest. Null: no cap.

repeat_throttle_hours.title: Repeat Throttle Hours
repeat_throttle_hours.description: Another story with the same holding and event type within this many hours of an alert is not alerted again.

quiet_all_day_on.title: Quiet All Day On
quiet_all_day_on.description: Days treated as quiet from start to end: alerts are held (or go to the digest) as during quiet hours. Holidays are the public holidays of holiday_country.

system_alert_severity.title: System Alert Severity
system_alert_severity.description: Severity of monitoring alerts (a failed job, a missed run, a holding with no news coverage); routed by the rules like any event. 0: never alert.

digest_channels.title: Digest Channels
digest_channels.description: Where the daily and weekly digests go.

index_url.title: Index Url
index_url.description: The SEC page listing the data sets (zip files).

datasets_per_run.title: Datasets Per Run
datasets_per_run.description: Data sets (about 100 MB each) loaded per run.

history_datasets.title: History Datasets
history_datasets.description: How far back to load: the newest this many data sets (one per quarter, so 8 is two years). An empty database is backfilled over successive runs, datasets_per_run at a time; the datasets step shows how many remain.

tracked_managers.title: Tracked Managers
tracked_managers.description: Managers whose new and exited positions in the portfolio's holdings appear in the next digest.

OwnershipSettings.title: OwnershipSettings
OwnershipSettings.description: Form 13F institutional ownership from the SEC's quarterly data sets.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: Date of the latest snapshot included.

points.title: Points
points.description: Daily flow-adjusted portfolio value index, 100 on the first day. Not a price: deposits and withdrawals are excluded, so day-over-day change is investment return only. Only meaningful rebased (against itself or the benchmark), never read as an absolute figure.

gap.title: Gap
gap.description: Why there is no portfolio history, when there is none.

freshness.description: Null until the first successful sync.

last_sync.description: The latest sync job, whatever its status.

base_currency_mismatch.title: Base Currency Mismatch
base_currency_mismatch.description: The active strategy's base currency differs from the snapshot's; the next sync converts to the new one.

band.title: Band
band.description: Allowed absolute deviation from the target, as a fraction (0.02 = ±2 pp).

hard_limit.title: Hard Limit
hard_limit.description: Weight above which the position raises an alert, not just a digest flag.

PositionWeightRule.title: PositionWeightRule
PositionWeightRule.description: Limit on a single position's weight; with no ticker it applies to every position.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: Date of the latest stored close.

correlations.title: Correlations
correlations.description: With each other holding, last 252 days.

gap.title: Gap
gap.description: Why there is no price history, when there is none.

plausibility.description: Latest Stooq close vs Trading212's price on a sync day.

benchmark_symbols.title: Benchmark Symbols
benchmark_symbols.description: Stooq symbols of the benchmarks (^spx S&P 500, ^dax DAX, ^ukx FTSE 100). The first is used for beta and the holding charts.

plausibility_tolerance_pct.title: Plausibility Tolerance Pct
plausibility_tolerance_pct.description: Largest gap between Stooq's close and Trading212's price on a sync day before it is flagged.

PriceSettings.title: PriceSettings
PriceSettings.description: Daily price history (Stooq) and the risk figures computed from it.

default_text.title: Default Text
default_text.description: The built-in prompt, used while no override is set.

overrides.title: Overrides
overrides.description: System prompt text per AI step, replacing the built-in default.

PromptsConfig.title: PromptsConfig
PromptsConfig.description: Stored as `config_version` rows, domain `prompts`. No override: the default is used.

rule_ids.title: Rule Ids
rule_ids.description: Strategy rule ids it rests on.

kpis.title: Kpis
kpis.description: Thesis KPIs it rests on, as TICKER:kpi_id.

ticker.title: Ticker
ticker.description: One holding, or all when null.

ticker.title: Ticker
ticker.description: One holding, or all when null.

openfigi_refresh_days.title: Openfigi Refresh Days
openfigi_refresh_days.description: Re-map each ISIN through OpenFIGI this often.

wikidata_enabled.title: Wikidata Enabled
wikidata_enabled.description: Read aliases and suggested relationships from Wikidata.

max_subsidiary_aliases.title: Max Subsidiary Aliases
max_subsidiary_aliases.description: Most GLEIF subsidiary names added to a holding's news aliases.

wikidata_languages.title: Wikidata Languages
wikidata_languages.description: Languages (ISO 639 codes) whose Wikidata labels and aliases are read.

ReferenceSettings.title: ReferenceSettings
ReferenceSettings.description: Identity and reference data: OpenFIGI, ESMA FIRDS/FITRS, GLEIF, Wikidata.

holding_profiles_version_id.title: Holding Profiles Version Id
holding_profiles_version_id.description: The new holding-profiles version, when the confirmation changed it.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: 1 GLEIF or a filing, 3 Wikidata; owner decisions win.

conflict.title: Conflict
conflict.description: Disputed: the contradicting source's claim (source, tier, object_name, source_ref).

decision.title: Decision
decision.description: What routing decided, in one line.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Channels an alert would be sent or held for.

alerts_before.title: Alerts Before
alerts_before.description: Events that would alert under the active config.

alerts_after.title: Alerts After
alerts_after.description: Events that would alert under the draft.

excerpt.title: Excerpt
excerpt.description: The matching passage, with matches in .

next_due_at.title: Next Due At
next_due_at.description: When the next report of this kind is scheduled.

next_due_at.title: Next Due At
next_due_at.description: When the next report of this kind is scheduled: this one is current until then. Null for unscheduled kinds or a disabled schedule.

dropped_sentences.title: Dropped Sentences
dropped_sentences.description: Model sentences removed for citing nothing checkable.

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: Sentences per model-written section: brief 3, standard 6, deep 12.

max_steps.title: Max Steps
max_steps.description: Claude calls plus web searches per run.

source_tiers.title: Source Tiers
source_tiers.description: Outlet tiers web search may use and the report may cite.

include_peers.title: Include Peers
include_peers.description: Name the holding's competitors and compare with them.

top_holders.title: Top Holders
top_holders.description: Largest 13F holders named in the ownership section.

ticker.title: Ticker
ticker.description: Any ticker, owned or not (a Trading212 ticker gives the richest data).

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Research profile id; default if omitted.

written_by.title: Written By
written_by.description: code (figures from stored records) or model

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: Snapshot date the compliance is judged on.

why.title: Why
why.description: Held by the validator, or quarantined by reconciliation.

failed_checks.title: Failed Checks
failed_checks.description: The checks (bounds) the figure broke, with their detail.

restates.description: The stored fact a restatement differs from.

use_batch.title: Use Batch
use_batch.description: Propose the actions through the Batch API (half price).

batch_wait_minutes.title: Batch Wait Minutes
batch_wait_minutes.description: How long to wait for the batch before proposing the actions directly.

liquidity_days.title: Liquidity Days
liquidity_days.description: A position larger than this many days of its home market's average daily turnover is flagged as hard to exit.

holder_drop_flag_pct.title: Holder Drop Flag Pct
holder_drop_flag_pct.description: A fall in a holding's 13F holder count of at least this percentage quarter on quarter is flagged.

ReviewSettings.title: ReviewSettings
ReviewSettings.description: The monthly review: compliance and figures in code, proposed actions by the model.

max_drawdown.title: Max Drawdown
max_drawdown.description: Worst fall from a peak, stored history.

beta.title: Beta
beta.description: Against the first benchmark, last 252 days.

check.title: Check
check.description: The claim verifier's result: supported, unsupported (kept only in 'mark' mode) or unchecked (the verifier could not run). Null: not checked.

id.title: Id
id.description: Short id cited by sentences, e.g. S3.

ref.title: Ref
ref.description: The stored record: fact id, accession, URL, ...

url.title: Url
url.description: External page, when there is one.

app_path.title: App Path
app_path.description: The app page for it, e.g. /evidence/12 or /holdings/X.

snippet.title: Snippet
snippet.description: The stored text it rests on.

demoted.title: Demoted
demoted.description: Below the threshold: counts one tier lower.

base_currency.title: Base Currency
base_currency.description: Currency every value is converted to for the overview and allocation.

fx_source.title: Fx Source
fx_source.description: Reference FX rates. Defaults to ČNB for a CZK base currency, ECB otherwise.

weight_basis.title: Weight Basis
weight_basis.description: 'total' weighs positions against positions plus cash; 'invested' against positions only.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Free-text guidance the AI reads; never evaluated by code.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Allocation dimensions. 'currency' is derived from the instrument unless a classification overrides it.

classifications.title: Classifications
classifications.description: Bucket per dimension for each holding, e.g. {'ASML_EQ': {'sector': 'Semis'}}.

hard_limit_severity.title: Hard Limit Severity
hard_limit_severity.description: Severity of a position above its hard limit (alerted when it opens, routed by the notification rules).

band_breach_severity.title: Band Breach Severity
band_breach_severity.description: Severity of a position, category or cash weight outside its target band. Severity 1 is listed in the next digest only; 2 or 3 also alert when it opens.

StrategyConfig.title: StrategyConfig
StrategyConfig.description:
The owner's investment strategy.

Stored as the body of `config_version` rows with domain `strategy`.

band.title: Band
band.description: Allowed absolute deviation from the target, as a fraction (0.02 = ±2 pp).

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: Which rule matched and what happens.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Channels the alert is queued for.

ThesesConfig.title: ThesesConfig
ThesesConfig.description: All theses. Stored as the body of `config_version` rows, domain `theses`.

exit_conditions.title: Exit Conditions
exit_conditions.description: Conditions that would end the thesis, in plain words.

metric.title: Metric
metric.description: Metric name the extraction job looks for.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: What the threshold is in: '%', 'x', 'count', or a currency with an optional scale ('EUR bn', 'USD m', 'USD' for per-share amounts).

ThesisKPI.title: ThesisKPI
ThesisKPI.description: An absolute threshold the owner sets. v1 has no consensus-estimate comparisons.

ticker.title: Ticker
ticker.description: One holding, or all when null.

accession.title: Accession
accession.description: The filing the position is read from.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Sum of `amount` over the filtered rows.

total_count.title: Total Count
total_count.description: Rows matching the filters, across all pages.

totals.title: Totals
totals.description: Sums per type, subtype and currency over every matching row.

dividends.title: Dividends
dividends.description: Dividend sums per currency over every matching row.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next (older) page; null on the last page.

wrong_penalty.title: Wrong Penalty
wrong_penalty.description: Score lost each time the owner marks it wrong.

useful_reward.title: Useful Reward
useful_reward.description: Score gained each time the owner marks it useful.

demote_below.title: Demote Below
demote_below.description: A source scoring below this counts one tier lower in corroboration (tier 1 as tier 2, tier 2 as tier 3).

TrustSettings.title: TrustSettings
TrustSettings.description: Source trust (layer 1): owner feedback moves a source's score between 0 and 1.

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: Judged under an older theses config than the active one; re-run verdicts.

sanity_max_change_qoq.title: Sanity Max Change Qoq
sanity_max_change_qoq.description: A figure that moves more than this fraction against the previous quarter's verified figure is held for review (0.5 = ±50 %). Null disables.

sanity_overrides.title: Sanity Overrides
sanity_overrides.description: Per-metric band replacing the default; null disables the bound for that metric (e.g. seasonal or often sign-changing figures).

stated_ratio_tolerance_pp.title: Stated Ratio Tolerance Pp
stated_ratio_tolerance_pp.description: How far (in percentage points) a ratio the document states may differ from the one recomputed from its raw figures before the stated one is rejected.

period_end_tolerance_days.title: Period End Tolerance Days
period_end_tolerance_days.description: Slack between a stated period end and the calendar month end expected from the fiscal year end (52/53-week fiscal years end on a weekday, not month end).

max_report_lag_days.title: Max Report Lag Days
max_report_lag_days.description: Latest a release may come out after the end of the period it reports.
